verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party analytics or reporting feature showing call volume, answer rate, or missed calls broken down per number and per teammate. The only related item is a developer tutorial for building your own custom Activity Tracker on the API. That is a developer building block, not the product's own capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate

citations.quote: Build a custom Activity Tracker to monitor and summarize Aircall user availabilities, call activities, and KPIs from a single view.
